narrative_job: Exit terminal and approach the open rear car door.
felt_intent: The viewer notices that her pace never changes even when the waiting car comes within reach.

authoring_state.dramatic_function: Turn public transit endurance into self-directed arrival at a chosen shelter.
authoring_state.turn: Rigid public endurance at the terminal becomes composure carried intact to the open car door.
authoring_state.pov: The traveler; the waiting car becomes legible through her fixed gaze before the crowd notices it.
authoring_state.power_shift: Rain and curb traffic dictate her pace at the threshold; at the car she controls the final approach by refusing to rush.
authoring_state.hidden_want_objective: Reach the waiting car without letting the curbside crowd see how exhausted she is.
authoring_state.obstacle_tactic: The long exposed curb, rain, and rolling suitcase invite a hurried release; she keeps one measured tempo and fixes her eyes on the open door.
authoring_state.subtext_contradiction: The car means relief, but her unchanged pace denies the crowd any performance of it.
authoring_state.visible_suppressed_behavior: At the last curb seam, her thumb hooks beneath the creased airline tag, then releases it without looking down.
authoring_state.non_transferable_detail: A creased paper airline tag looped around the suitcase handle catches under her thumb at the last curb seam.
authoring_state.stock_solution_refused: No relieved smile, sagging shoulders, or backward glance; replace them with the thumb catching and releasing the tag while her pace stays even.
authoring_state.value_before: arrival is public endurance with shelter still distant
authoring_state.value_after: shelter is reached while public composure remains intact
prompt_carriers: She sees the open rear door but keeps the same measured walking tempo.
